CustomField.description: Classifies the type of loan component represented by this Debt Position under the governing loan agreement (e.g. term loan, revolving facility, bond).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Identifies the type of loan component under the agreement (e.g. term loan, revolver, bond). Use a separate Debt Position for each component documented under the same agreement. This field describes what the loan is, not how it was originated or amended. Term Loan = fixed principal loan. Revolving Credit = draw-and-repay facility. Delayed Draw Term Loan = committed but drawn later. Bridge Loan = short-term financing. Bond = debt security issued under a bond/note agreement. Other = explain in notes.
CustomField.label: Loan Component Type
